changelog: New voice command "read last character" — say "read last character" alone while dictating (or "শেষ অক্ষর পড়ে শোনাও") and the last letter before the cursor is read aloud, so you can check a single letter by ear — the last letter of a name, a code, or an English spelling. Before, you had to hear the whole word or message. Nothing else changed — it never sends a message or deletes text you typed.
